content: The dedicated CRUD mutations/queries module is `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — it holds create, update, delete, get, and list operations. Let me confirm the client import and its definition.

q17.

`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient`

This hook module holds the memo CRUD mutations/queries — `createMemo` (line 183), `updateMemo` (202), `deleteMemo` (258), plus the `getMemo`/`listMemos`/`listMemoComments` queries — all issued through `memoServiceClient`, imported from `@/connect`.

That client is the generated Connect client for the `MemoService` proto, defined in `web/src/connect.ts:197` (`createClient(MemoService, transport)`), where `MemoService` comes from the generated `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.

(Note: `web/src/components/MemoEditor/services/memoService.ts` also wraps the same client for editor save/create-comment flows, but the general-purpose CRUD hook module is `useMemoQueries.ts`.)
